title: Nonvanishing of each polynomial factor
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j<k$. Then $\sum_{i=1}^n x_i-[2(a+j)-n+1]\ne0$, where $a=\lfloor(n-k)/2\rfloor$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
